title: Goldreich–Levin Learning Program
statement: Given a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input, define a membership-query learning program in the input dimension by translating the deterministic Goldreich–Levin learner into a learning program. Its output is a sparse Fourier hypothesis in that dimension.
hypotheses_covered: The input's small-bias parameters have positive dimension and numerator, with twice the numerator at most the denominator.
The Fourier bound is a natural number at least one.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the translation from deterministic query programs to learning programs or the learner being translated.
